activityDescription: Each contact goes to Club Log as you log it
noTokenShort: Connect your Club Log account to start streaming
accountDescription: Sends the contacts of an operation with the Club Log Livestream activity to your Club Log log as you make them
tokenPostface: Make one on clublog.org under Settings → API, and paste it here. It starts with cl_. Club Log shows it only once.
tokenMissing: Enter your Club Log API token
callNotHeld: Club Log accepted the token, but its account does not hold {{call}}, so contacts logged as {{call}} will be refused. Add {{call}} to your Club Log account, or use a token from the account that holds it.
noToken: This operation streams to Club Log, but there is no Club Log account yet. Add your API token under Settings → Accounts → Club Log.
tokenRefused: Club Log did not accept your API token, so nothing is being sent. Make a new one on clublog.org under Settings → API and enter it under Settings → Accounts → Club Log.
callRefused: Club Log will not take contacts for {{call}} with this token: {{message}}. Add {{call}} to your Club Log account, or use a token from the account that holds it.
rejected: Club Log refused the contact with {{theirCall}}: {{message}}
